title: Megamono structural check executor
description: Validate project tags, dependency direction, package placement, and rule overrides.

json.description: Emit raw, allowed, baselined, new, resolved and error findings as JSON without changing validation or policy.

ci.description: Reject development-only package addresses and verify registry routing plus the frozen lockfile.

profile.description: Apply the named package-source policy profile. CI=true selects ci when omitted.

excludeProjects.description: Projects this run deliberately omits from its install (for example pnpm --filter=!<package>), as names or a comma-separated list. Their manifests, and override/catalog addresses the committed pnpm lockfile reaches only through them, are reported as warnings instead of package-source profile violations. Structural checks still cover every project; the release profile rejects exclusions.
